2. Mark the field as `@deprecated` in [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L26) and [`Order`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/order.ts#L16-L29) during the transition window.
3. Remove the field only after the deprecation period and schema version rollout are complete.
